title: Application of Eastern Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L c. 164, § 94G, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 131, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to metter readings taken in the billilng months of March, April and May 1986. The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge recovers the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation and its calculation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
